items.title: Understanding the development of consciousness | Eva Jablonka
items.description:
Eva Jablonka discusses evolution and epigenetics.

Is there more to evolution than genetics?

Many view the questions of consciousness as fundamentally unanswerable. But evolutionary biologist Eva Jablonka argues that by studying the evolutionary origins of consciousness, we can better understand its nature and work out what we should and shouldn't attribute consciousness to.
